import sys

class Sensor:
    total_sensors = 0
    
    def __init__(self, sensor_id, temperature):
        self.sensor_id = sensor_id
        self.temperature = temperature
        Sensor.total_sensors += 1
    
    def update_temperature(self, temp):
        self.temperature = temp
    
    def get_temperature(self):
        return self.temperature
    
    @classmethod
    def get_total_sensors(cls):
        return cls.total_sensors

def main():
    lines = sys.stdin.read().strip().split('\n')
    if not lines:
        return
    
    # Parse first line: sensorID temperature
    parts = lines[0].strip().split()
    sensor_id = int(parts[0])
    temperature = float(parts[1])
    
    # Parse second line: newTemperature
    new_temp = float(lines[1].strip()) if len(lines) > 1 else temperature
    
    # Create sensor object
    sensor = Sensor(sensor_id, temperature)
    
    # Output results
    print(f"Initial Temperature: {sensor.get_temperature():.2f}")
    sensor.update_temperature(new_temp)
    print(f"Updated Temperature: {sensor.get_temperature():.2f}")
    print(f"Total Sensors Created: {Sensor.get_total_sensors()}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
